title: Maruman Mnemosyne Notebook A4
description_en: The Maruman Mnemosyne is the choice of architects and creative professionals: smooth 7mm ruled paper, a wire-bound A4 format, and a distinctive monochrome cover that means business.
description_ja: 建築家やクリエイターが愛用するマルマンのニーモシネ。7mm罫線のA4サイズ、ワイヤーリングで開きやすく、ハードな現場でも活躍。
